text: In the self-attention formula Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V used in Transformers, what is the key architectural advantage over RNNs?
choices: Attention requires strictly sequential processing, one position at a time
Attention can only be computed after the entire RNN hidden state has been unrolled
Every position can attend to every other position in parallel, removing the sequential bottleneck of RNNs
Attention eliminates the need for any training data
explanation: Self-attention allows every position to directly attend to every other position simultaneously, enabling parallel computation and removing the sequential bottleneck that limits RNNs and LSTMs on long sequences. Option 0 actually describes RNN behavior rather than the Transformer advantage, option 1 incorrectly makes attention dependent on RNN unrolling, and option 3 is not meaningful since Transformers still require large training datasets.
